purpose: Teach: メモリアル/ハウル/ヨドバシカメラ/ポケモン/ファミコン/東宝/オカルト/サントリー

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、修学旅行でメモリアル碑見たろ
lines.en: Hey Riku — you saw that memorial monument on the school trip, right?
lines.style: Casual, testing tone. Leans in slightly. Watches for his reaction. Light curiosity masking something sharper underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ハウルの動く城ハマってたな、桜
lines.en: You're the one who got obsessed with Howl's Moving Castle, Sakura.
lines.style: Quick parry. Wry half-smile. Deflecting with humour — turning the observation back on her before she can settle into it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ヨドバシカメラでガジェット買ってたな
lines.en: Riku, I saw you buying gadgets at Yodobashi Camera.
lines.style: Catches him. Direct but not unkind. Slight satisfaction in calling him out. Watching to see if he'll dodge again.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ポケモンカード集めてたな、桜
lines.en: You collected Pokémon cards though, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Soft counter-strike. Not mean. Just — you do the same thing. Tired but genuine. Meeting her halfway.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん父さん、ファミコン世代だな
lines.en: Your dad's basically a Famicom era guy, Riku.
lines.style: Observation landing with a smirk. Casual cruelty wrapped in affection. Knows it'll get under his skin and doesn't mind.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、東宝映画好きだな、桜
lines.en: You love Toho movies though, don't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet return. Not defensive now — just honest. Noticing something she actually does care about. Gentle redirect.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、オカルト動画見すぎだぞ
lines.en: Riku, you watch way too much of that occult stuff.
lines.style: Exasperated but affectionate. Shaking her head slightly. The tone of someone who's noticed and filed it away because she actually cares.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前ん父さん、サントリーで働いてたな、桜
lines.en: Your dad used to work at Suntory, didn't he, Sakura?
lines.style: Close and quiet. Intimate observation — he's been paying attention. Slight hesitation, like he's revealing something he noticed.
